name: Temporal Rift
description: A rift in time rapidly ages and slows anyone who draws near.
disable: DC 36 Arcana (master) or Occultism (master) to magically mend time, DC 40 Thievery (master) to repair the time rift, or Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the rift

offensiveAbilities.name: Time Shudder
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the rift

Effect The triggering creature takes 6d10+20 damage as its body rapidly ages. It must attempt a DC 33 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes Clumsy 1 and Enfeebled 1.

Failure The creature takes full damage, and becomes Clumsy 2 and Enfeebled 2.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes clumsy 2 and enfeebled 2, and becomes slowed for 1 minute.
